editorial: Imagine a weekend that turns into a nightmare, where the only escape is watching yourself die. This psychological horror pushes the setting of a manicured island resort into a claustrophobic arena of judgment, and every corridor feels like a cell. Joaquin Phoenix delivers a quietly menacing monologue that turns the camera into an accomplice of the psyche. You will feel both voyeur and condemned, drawn into a game that questions the value of freedom. Pacing falters at moments, yet the film’s relentless dread remains compelling.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
